# Shiloh & Smith Solutions

> Professional conference interpretation equipment, certified simultaneous linguists, and audio engineering across East Africa and globally.

## Overview
Shiloh & Smith Solutions is a specialized language and conference technology provider based in Nairobi, Kenya. The company supplies ISO-compliant soundproof mobile interpretation booths, Danish Interpretation Systems (DIS) digital interpreter consoles, delegate discussion microphone systems, multichannel infrared (IR) receivers, and accredited conference interpreters.

## Core Capabilities
- **Simultaneous & Consecutive Interpretation:** Working across 6 major languages: French, English, Spanish, Portuguese, Kiswahili, and Arabic.
- **Interpretation Equipment Rental:** ISO 4043 & ISO 2603 soundproof booths, DIS digital interpreter stations, push-to-talk gooseneck delegate mics, infrared wireless receivers, and stethophone headsets.
- **Remote Simultaneous Interpretation (RSI):** Cloud and hybrid meeting audio integration with Zoom Multilingual Audio Channels, Microsoft Teams, Webex, and Interprefy.
- **Certified Translation Services:** Technical, diplomatic, humanitarian, and legal document translations with certified notarization.
- **Conference Audio-Visual (AV):** Full stage sound reinforcement, projection, delegate discussion management, and event audio technicians.

## Operational Footprint
- **Headquarters:** Nairobi, Kenya
- **Deployment Coverage:** Kenya, Rwanda, Uganda, Tanzania, Burundi, South Sudan, DRC, and international virtual summits.
